subject: small chubby green dragon whelp with an orange belly, little bat wings and a long tail, standing on all fours
motion: flapping its wings to take off and hover
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: small dust swirls under the wings

plan.source: Dragon whelp stands three-quarter facing right, head up, wings relaxed half-open, long tail curled behind, all four paws planted.

frames.pose: Anticipation: torso sinks back, head dips; front paws spread and brace, hind paws firm; wings lift high behind; tail lowers for balance.
frames.effect: Small dust swirls gather on ground under each wing base.

frames.pose: Push: chest rises; front paws lift; hind paws on toes driving; wings slam halfway down; head up; tail flicks up.
frames.effect: Air-cut arcs along both wingtips; dust swirls puff outward under wings.

frames.pose: Key: both paws tucked as body lifts; wings at full downstroke wide; head proud; tail trailing down-right curve.
frames.effect: Dust swirls linger under wings on ground; short trails behind wingtips.

frames.pose: Hover settle: wings sweep up past mid; body slightly lower; forelegs extend, hind legs relaxed; head steady; tail curls.
frames.effect: Faint dust swirls fade under wings.

frames.pose: Recovery: descend to touch; hind paws land first, fronts reaching; wings midway up starting to fold; head levels; tail drops.
frames.effect: Small dust puffs under wings on touchdown.
